item.text:
Yes. Mistral’s Document QnA can answer questions about images such as `.png` and `.jpg`; it is not limited to PDFs.

Use an image as an `image_url` (or Base64-encoded image) rather than a `document_url`. Mistral’s documentation explicitly describes QnA over PDFs, photos, and screenshots, while the OCR API documents image support for PNG and JPEG/JPG.  

- [Document QnA cookbook](https://docs.mistral.ai/resources/cookbooks/mistral-ocr-document_understanding)
- [OCR Processor: images and PDFs](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/document-processing/basic_ocr)
- [Document QnA API examples](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/document-processing/document_qna)
